definitions.de: Basis, Fundament, Sockel (die Grundlage oder Unterlage, auf der etwas steht oder aufgebaut ist)
definitions.en: Base, foundation, pedestal (the ground or underlying support on which something is built or stands)
definitions.es: Base, fundamento, pedestal (la base o soporte sobre el que algo se construye o se apoya)
definitions.fr: Base, fondation, socle (le support ou la fondation sur lequel quelque chose est construit ou repose)
definitions.hi: आधार, नींव, पेडस्टल (वह आधार जिस पर कुछ बना हो या खड़ा हो)
definitions.ja: 基盤、土台、台座（何かが建てられたり立っている基礎や支え）
definitions.km: មូលដ្ឋាន, គ្រឹះ, ជើង (ជំនួយ ឬគ្រឹះដែលអ្វីមួយសាងសង់ ឬដំណើរការ)
definitions.ko: 기반, 토대, 받침 (무언가가 세워지거나 서 있는 기초나 지지대)
definitions.ne: आधार, जग, पेडस्टल (त्यो आधार जसमा केही निर्मित वा खडा छ)
definitions.pt: Base, fundação, pedestal (a base ou suporte sobre o qual algo é construído ou se apoia)
definitions.th: ฐาน, รากฐาน, แท่น (พื้นฐานหรือสิ่งรองรับที่สิ่งใดสิ่งหนึ่งถูกสร้างหรือตั้งอยู่)
definitions.tl: Pundasyon, base, pedestal (ang pundasyon o suporta kung saan nakatayo o naitayo ang isang bagay)
definitions.ur: بنیاد، بیس، پیڈسٹل (وہ بنیاد یا سہارا جس پر کوئی چیز بنی ہو یا کھڑی ہو)
definitions.vi: Nền tảng, cơ sở, bệ (phần nền hoặc chỗ đỡ mà thứ gì đó được xây dựng hoặc đứng trên đó)
definitions.zh: 基础、底座、台基（某物建立或站立于其上的根基或支撑）
definitions.zh_Hant: 基礎、底座、台基（某物建立或站立於其上的根基或支撐）

definition_en: Base, foundation, pedestal (the ground or underlying support on which something is built or stands)

lao_examples.lao_script: ຖານຂອງເສົາໂຕນີ້ບໍ່ແຂງແຮງ
lao_examples.romanization: tʰaːn kʰɔːŋ sao to niː bɔː kʰɛŋ hɛːŋ
lao_examples.translation_en: The base of this pillar is not strong.

lao_examples.lao_script: ຕ້ອງສ້າງຖານໃຫ້ດີກ່ອນ

lao_examples.translation_en: You have to build a good foundation first.
